versions.summary: Annex, Calculator, index tracking across the site, and fund switching in reports.

sections.title: New
items: Annex (footer): Prudential product brochures in English and Chinese, grouped the way Prudential sorts them. Plans can sit in several categories and carry any number of tags. Brochures open in a popup with zoom and download, and the plan name opens its product page. The list refreshes every 2 weeks.
Calculator (footer): the PRUShield premium calculator now lives here, alongside a new PruCredit$ calculator.

PruCredit$ calculator: add plans by typing, pasting, dropping a screenshot or taking a photo (a screen capture on computers, the camera on phones and tablets). A breakdown can be downloaded once a plan is added.
Market indices: Market Performance shows Top 10 and Lower 10 performers for both funds and indices.
Market News: shows the indices each story may affect, filters by index, and can show all news, funds only or indices only.
Report Generation, step 6 – Fund switching: switch a percentage of units between funds. A 100% switch also redirects future top-ups.
Report Generation: BID prices can be changed for purchases, end dates and switches. Published prices are used unless you change them.
Changelog: click the version number in the footer to see what changed.

sections.title: Improved
items: PRUShield: age next birthday can be chosen from a list, typed in, or worked out from a date of birth.
Generated reports list the fund switches carried out and any BID prices you entered.
Lower 10 performers stay hidden until you open them, and hide again on refresh.
Monitoring: watchlist and alerts show 1M, 3M and 6M by default for funds and indices.
Clearer tag contrast in every theme and colour palette.

sections.title: Removed
items: PRUShield from the main navigation (now under Calculator).
The fund data source line in the footer.
